candidate: Crotaphytus collaris Peck Ranch/Stegall Mountain metapopulation

scientific_anchor.window_reason: published field protocol reports at least three visits per glade per field season on Stegall from 1995-2006; no human-assisted translocations occurred after the original 1984/1987/1989 releases
scientific_anchor.source_process_claim: after the last human-assisted release in 1989, colonisation/recolonisation on Stegall is conditioned on occupied glades in the mapped Stegall glade universe; woodland burn management is a known time-varying external condition and must be represented prospectively or the candidate stops before response

prospective_endpoint.state: occupied if the frozen annual glade population-size source records positive estimated population size; otherwise zero may be assigned only when the complete glade registry and published annual all-glade survey coverage jointly certify that omission represents a surveyed non-detection
prospective_endpoint.event: survey-certified zero at t to occupied at t+1
prospective_endpoint.non_event: survey-certified zero at t to survey-certified zero at t+1
prospective_endpoint.missing_or_unsurveyed: exclude only if prospectively documented as unsurveyed before response; otherwise stop
prospective_endpoint.no_capture_row_inference: do not infer surveyed zero merely from absence of an individual capture row

gps_registry_contract.physical_format: Garmin text export: line 1 metadata, line 2 tabular header, each waypoint data line has exactly nine tab-delimited fields
gps_registry_contract.ste g all_note: physical naming in the source omits the hyphen used in some publications
gps_registry_contract.stegall_name_rule: uppercase literal name begins with SM and the remainder matches one or more digits optionally followed by uppercase letters; no fuzzy aliasing
gps_registry_contract.row_rule: all physical waypoint rows must parse; the analysis registry is exactly every row whose physical Name matches the frozen Stegall regex
gps_registry_contract.coordinate_rule: latitude and longitude must be finite decimal degrees; selected names and coordinate pairs must both be unique; no selected row may be dropped or repaired
gps_registry_contract.registry_closure_evidence: Zenodo describes GPS waypoints as latitude/longitude of the glades in this study; the published 1995-2006 Stegall protocol visits each glade at least three times per field season
gps_registry_contract.distance_rule: great-circle haversine distance in kilometres with Earth radius 6371.0088 km
